_comment: Manual override list for famous bearers Wikidata misses. Common reason: Roman names where the structured P735 'given name' is the praenomen (Gaius, Publius, Quintus...) but the figure is universally known by their nomen or cognomen. Entries are prepended to ENRICHMENT[name].famous and pass through filter_famous_for, so the first token of 'name' must match the page name. Key = slugified name.
